blocks.orig: The Marimbani sandbank is a beautiful half-moon-shaped sand island in the Mafia Archipelago. This sandbank slowly appears when the tide starts to go out, revealing itself for a few hours before the Indian Ocean swallows it up again. A traditional dhow takes you to the heart of the marine park for some snorkelling before you head to Marimbani. While you take your time to explore the sandbank and its surrounding waters, the staff cooks a delicious Swahili-style BBQ’d fish.
blocks.html: In the Mafia Archipelago lies the Marimbani sandbank, a lovely sand island shaped like a half moon. As the tide begins to drop, the sandbank gradually emerges, staying visible for a few hours until the Indian Ocean covers it again. On a traditional dhow you sail into the heart of the marine park to snorkel, after which you continue to Marimbani. While you calmly explore the sandbank and the water around it, the crew prepares a tasty Swahili-style BBQ’d fish.
